description: Failure detected during a planned, periodic functional test or inspection of the item
examples: Fire and gas detection system test; emergency shutdown valve stroke test

description: Failure detected by monitoring of physical parameters to determine item condition
Failure detected during scheduled inspection, visual or instrument-based
Failure detected automatically by installed monitoring equipment during operation
examples: Online leak detection; continuous pressure or temperature monitoring

description: Failure detected during planned preventive maintenance activity
examples: Finding a worn seal during scheduled pump overhaul

description: Failure detected when the item is required to operate
examples: Emergency system fails to start on demand

description: Failure detected by operational personnel during routine operation
examples: Operator hears abnormal noise or notices abnormal readings

description: Failure detected by maintenance personnel during unrelated maintenance activity
examples: Technician finds damage while working on another component

description: Failure detected by methods other than those specified above
examples: Any detection method not otherwise classified
